The continuously compounded growth equation is

$$
\begin{aligned} P &= P_0e^{rt}. \end{aligned}
$$

We have a final amount of $P=20\,500$, a rate of $r=0.052$, and a time duration of $t=14$ days. Substituting these values into the formula and solving for $P_0$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}
P &= P_{0}e^{rt} \\
20500 &= P_{0}e^{(0.052)(14)} \\
20500 &= P_{0}e^{0.728} \\
20500 &= P_{0}(2.07093...) \\
P_{0} &= \frac{20500}{2.07093...} \\
&= P_{0} \mid \approx 9899
\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, there were $9\,899$ bacteria initially.

The continuously compounded growth equation is $P=P_0e^{rt}$. Here $P_0=102$, $P=10$, and $r=-0.095$ per year. Solve for $t$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
10 &= 102e^{-0.095t} \\
e^{-0.095t} &= \frac{10}{102} \\
-0.095t &= \ln\left(\frac{10}{102}\right) \\
t &= \frac{\ln(10/102)}{-0.095} \\
&\approx 24.4462.
\end{aligned}
$$

Rounding to the nearest integer gives $24$ years.

The continuously compounded growth equation is $P=P_0e^{rt}$. Here $P_0=10$, $P=781$, and $t=14$ minutes. Solve for $r$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
781 &= 10e^{14r} \\
e^{14r} &= \frac{781}{10} \\
14r &= \ln\left(\frac{781}{10}\right) \\
r &= \frac{\ln(781/10)}{14} \\
&\approx 0.311285.
\end{aligned}
$$

The percentage rate is approximately $31.1285\%$ per minute. Rounding to the nearest percent gives $31\%$ per minute.

The continuously compounded growth equation is $P=P_0e^{rt}$. Here $P_0=4120$, $r=-0.0381$ per year, and $t=2016-2009=7$ years. Substitute:

$$
\begin{aligned}
P &= 4120e^{(-0.0381)(7)} \\
&= 4120e^{-0.2667} \\
&\approx 3155.5196.
\end{aligned}
$$

Rounding to the nearest integer gives approximately $3156$ crimes in $2016$.

The continuously compounded growth equation is $P=P_0e^{rt}$. Here $P_0=9830$ and $r=-0.18$ per day. Convert $2$ weeks to $t=14$ days, then substitute:

$$
\begin{aligned}
P &= 9830e^{(-0.18)(14)} \\
&= 9830e^{-2.52} \\
&\approx 790.9179.
\end{aligned}
$$

Rounding to the nearest integer gives approximately $791$ people.

The continuously compounded growth equation is $P=P_0e^{rt}$. Here $P=16700$, $r=0.15$ per year, and $t=5$ years. Solve for the earlier profit $P_0$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
16700 &= P_0e^{(0.15)(5)} \\
P_0 &= \frac{16700}{e^{0.75}} \\
&\approx 7888.5214.
\end{aligned}
$$

Rounding to the nearest dollar, the profit five years ago was $\$7889$.

The continuously compounded growth equation is $P=P_0e^{rt}$. Here $P=3.11$, $r=-0.01$ per month, and $t=5$ months. Solve for the earlier gas price $P_0$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
3.11 &= P_0e^{(-0.01)(5)} \\
P_0 &= \frac{3.11}{e^{-0.05}} \\
&\approx 3.269453.
\end{aligned}
$$

Rounding to the nearest cent, the earlier price was $\$3.27$ per gallon.
